description: Provision a Google Cloud Storage StorageBucketAccessControl via Config Connector. Fields mirror the storage.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1 StorageBucketAccessControl spec.

bucketRef.description: Reference to the bucket. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: Allowed value: The `name` field of a `StorageBucket` resource.

name.description: Name of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names/#names

namespace.description: Namespace of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/namespaces/

entity.description:
Immutable. The entity holding the permission, in one of the following forms:
  user-userId
  user-email
  group-groupId
  group-email
  domain-domain
  project-team-projectId
  allUsers
  allAuthenticatedUsers
Examples:
  The user liz@example.com would be user-liz@example.com.
  The group example@googlegroups.com would be
  group-example@googlegroups.com.
  To refer to all members of the Google Apps for Business domain
  example.com, the entity would be domain-example.com.

projectId.description: GCP project ID for this resource. Rendered as the cnrm.cloud.google.com/project-id annotation. Leave empty to inherit the project from the namespace (Config Connector falls back to the namespace's project-id annotation, then to the namespace name). Leave empty when this resource's spec already carries a projectRef.
projectId.title: GCP project ID

role.description: The access permission for the entity. Possible values: ["OWNER", "READER", "WRITER"].
